name: Webster Vienna Private University
summary: Webster University's Vienna campus (US-based): five English bachelor's in business, politics, psychology, media, computing; law pending approval.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is accepted, with a minimum school GPA of 2.5 out of 4 or equivalent (no IB conversion given). IB English proves English: HL A 4, HL B 5, SL A 5 or SL B 6.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.ib: Austrian BSc and a US degree from Webster University; emphases in entrepreneurship, HR, international business or marketing.

programmes.name: Computer Science with an Emphasis in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.ib: Needs IB Maths HL (AA or AI) at 5 or SL at 6, a recommendation letter on your tech skills, and evidence of activities such as coding or robotics.

programmes.name: Comparative International Business Law
programmes.ib: Pending AQ Austria and Higher Learning Commission approval; not accredited by the American or Austrian Bar Association.

notes: For 2026 entry the EU/EEA deadline was 31 July 2026 and the non-EU one 31 March 2026; the 2027 dates are not yet published.
New students pay a €1,000 registration deposit before they can register for classes.
